colors.name: Navy
colors.role: Strap/headline text in latestnews.css; also the main fill in the site's header logo SVG

typography.role: Section font for the latest-news block (font-family: Aeonik)

notes: No brand guidelines published; the IAA Logo Policy (April 2023) covers logo permission only and gives no colours or fonts. Site main CSS is the Bootstrap 5 default theme (#0d6efd etc.), which was ignored. Colour and font come from the site's own Content/css/latestnews.css (and tile.css uses Aeonik too); the navy matches a fill in the logo SVG seen on the site. The logo SVG itself was not stored (restricted).
